name: Ranger
description: A keen-eyed marksman who picks off enemies from range while supporting allies with traps and tracking.
lore: Rangers of the Thornwood patrol the wild frontiers where civilization ends. Their bows strike true, their traps ensnare, and their knowledge of beasts makes them invaluable when monstrous enemies appear.

abilities.name: Precise Shot
abilities.description: A carefully aimed arrow. +10% crit chance.

abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description: Marks a target to take 15% more damage from all sources for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.description: Fires a rain of arrows hitting all enemies.

abilities.name: Snare Trap
abilities.description: Immobilizes one enemy for 2 turns and deals minor damage.

abilities.name: Beast Lore
abilities.description: All allies deal 15% more damage (30% vs beasts) for 4 turns.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.description: Passive: +15% crit rate. Attacks cannot be dodged.

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.description: Ultimate: Guaranteed crit for 4x damage, ignores Physical DEF, stuns for 2 turns.

synergies: Rogue: Hunter's Mark + Death Mark stacks for massive single-target focus
Mage: Snare Trap pins targets for guaranteed spell hits
Warrior: Beast Lore damage buff enhances even the Warrior's attacks
weaknesses: Below-average HP — not as squishy as Mage but can't take sustained hits
Moderate INT means mediocre magic defense
hire_description: A weathered hunter sits in the corner, fletching arrows with practiced ease. A massive longbow leans against the wall beside her. "I can put an arrow through a goblin's eye at 200 paces. That useful enough for you?"
